name: Discover it Miles

regular_apr: 18.24% to 27.24% variable, depending on your credit

rating_reason: Simple earning structure with a first-year match that doubles your miles. Miles redeem as a statement credit against travel purchases. Lacks transfer partners, which limits value for experienced travelers.
best_for: first travel card for someone who wants simplicity and no foreign transaction fee
skip_if: you are comfortable managing points programs and want to maximize value through airline or hotel transfers
